fields.description: Policy applied when a Project's committed/actual cost exceeds its approved Project Cost Baseline (DEC-09).
fields.label: Cost Overrun Policy

fields.description: ODS-1: blocks creating or submitting a second independently active Deal Cost Sheet for the same Opportunity. Cancel -> Amend lineage is always permitted and never counted as a duplicate. Created disabled by default; activation is an owner decision.
fields.label: Enable One Active Deal Cost Sheet Per Opportunity Guard

fields.description: Blocks direct Desk/REST edits to the Deal Cost Sheet commercial control fields (governed by the Negotiation, Approval, Award and Handover workspaces) and enforces the NRC-1 protected-field-name channel on Closure Notes. Created disabled by default; activation is an owner decision.
fields.label: Enable Deal Cost Sheet Governed Field Guard

fields.description: Validates Record Authority / Superseded By supersession metadata on Deal Cost Sheet and logs a DCS Governance Event on every authority change. Created disabled by default; activation is an owner decision.
fields.label: Enable Deal Cost Sheet Record Authority Guard

fields.description: When a check-in location does not match any Head Office, look up its address via the free OpenStreetMap Nominatim API.
fields.label: Enable Reverse Geocoding

fields.description: Nominatim's usage policy requires a contact identifier in the request. Leave blank to send a generic identifier with no contact details.
fields.label: Contact Email for API Requests

fields.description: Minimum seconds between API requests (Nominatim allows max 1 request/sec).
fields.label: Minimum Request Interval (sec)

fields.description: How long a resolved address is cached before it is looked up again.
fields.label: Cache TTL (Days)
